handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by idle Codex2; previous owner Claude becomes reviewer.

STRAT-003 ready for review. Added side-effect-free Source/Evidence -> StrategySpec conversion service that builds StrategySpecSeed, converts it into schema-backed draft StrategySpec, emits registry facade payload with source_seed_id lineage, inline storage_ref, checksum, and candidate advance request, and preserves evidence/code lineage without registry writes or execution routes. Evidence: support/evidence/STRAT-003/README.md. Verification: py_compile conversion/test; pytest services/research/strategy_spec/test_conversion.py -q (4 passed); pytest services/research/strategy_spec -q (19 passed); pytest services/source_ingestion/tests/test_strategy_seed_builder.py -q (5 passed); pytest services/registry/test_service.py -q (44 passed); git diff --check targeted STRAT-003 files.

Review approved: side-effect-free conversion confirmed, safety metadata triple enforced and cannot be overridden, lineage preserved through existing helpers, registry payload matches STRAT-002 facade contract, 4+19+5+44 tests all pass. Returning to Codex for finalization.
